update.releaseNotes:
v1.6.0 - watch your queue from your PC, and stop after this career
- New: watch your queue from your PC on a live dashboard (setup is in the README). - New: Stop after this career, on Home or the dashboard: the bot finishes its career, then pauses the queue. - New: live progress in the notification and a Last session card on Home. - New: sturdier overnight queues, with errors retried and the Data Download prompt handled. - New: presets keep your timing, OCR, display and stop settings. - Fixed: Stop in the notification now stops the bot, Start is no longer refused after Import or Reset Settings, and your fast Skip is no longer switched to slow. - Fixed: the bot stops before Start Career if a deck holds a card of the trainee's own character, and Trackblazer items are now used from the Training screen. - Do this: enter the access code shown in Debug Settings to open the dashboard, and Trackblazer players should check Consecutive Races Limit once.
